Greetings, **rozraid**! Here is a complete strategic summary of your account's progress and journey, along with a tailored tactical roadmap to get your Hunter from level 71 to 83 for your City of Um endeavors.

---

### 🛡️ Character & Journey Profile Summary

You are a **Level 120 Combat Specialist** with a strong leaning toward high-tier combat and quest progression, highlighted by massive dedication to Necromancy and Slayer.

| Category | Level / Status | Notable Highlights |

#### 📜 Profile Narrative & Milestones
* **The Necromancy Master:** Your highest and most defined skill is **106 Necromancy**. You recently completed [*Tomes of the Warlock*](https://runescape.wiki/w/Tomes_of_the_Warlock), unlocking key ancient secrets and expanding your mastery over the Underworld.
* **Questing & Exploration:** With 330 Quest Points, you are well down the path to endgame content. Your previous efforts involved unlocking Menaphos reputation and completing core prerequisites.
* **Slayer & Combat Base:** Standing at 95 Slayer paired with your Full Slayer Helmet, you are primed for elite mob grinding and high-end bossing.

---

### 🎯 Current Mission: Level 71 ➔ 83 Hunter

Your target is reaching **Level 83 Hunter**, which unlocks the ability to catch [Moonstone butterflies](https://runescape.wiki/w/Moonstone_butterfly) in the [City of Um](https://runescape.wiki/w/City_of_Um) for Underworld achievements and city collectibles.

* **Current Level:** 71 (831,956 XP)
* **Target Level:** 83 (2,670,587 XP)
* **XP Required:** **1,838,631 XP**

---

### 🏹 Tactical Roadmap: Fast Hunter 71 ➔ 83

Below is the optimal progression path using current mechanics. Consult the [Pay-to-play Hunter training guide](https://runescape.wiki/w/Pay-to-play_Hunter_training) for full details on trap setups.

#### 1. Levels 71–75: Black Warlocks or Carnivorous Chinchompas
* **Option A – Barehand Butterflies (Fast & Easy):** Catch [Black warlocks](https://runescape.wiki/w/Black_warlock) in the [Piscatoris Hunter area](https://runescape.wiki/w/Piscatoris_Hunter_area) (or Feldip Hills). Requires level 65 Hunter and gives ~650 XP per catch with no gear setup required.
* **Option B – Box Trapping:** Catch [Carnivorous chinchompas](https://runescape.wiki/w/Carnivorous_chinchompa) south of the Feldip Hills. 
* **Daily Bonus:** Run the daily [*Big Chinchompa*](https://runescape.wiki/w/Big_Chinchompa) Distraction & Diversion for rapid chunk XP and reward tickets.

#### 2. Levels 75–83: Big Game Hunter (BGH) or Grenwalls
* **Recommended Active Method: [Big Game Hunter](https://runescape.wiki/w/Big_Game_Hunter)**
  * **Requirement:** Level 75 Hunter (unlocked at tier 1 skinning).
  * **Location:** [Anachronia](https://runescape.wiki/w/Anachronia).
  * **Why:** Excellent active gameplay, heavy XP yields per hunt, and chance at valuable drops (dinosaur leather, dragon mattock, Hunter marks). Start with the *Arcane Apoterrasaur* or *Spicati Apoterrasaur*.
* **Alternative AFK / Fast Method: [Grenwalls](https://runescape.wiki/w/Grenwall)**
  * Unlockable at level 77 Hunter (or lower with boosts).
  * Best done in the [Private Hunter Portal](https://runescape.wiki/w/Gorajo_hoardstalker_dungeon) in the Gorajo dungeon (requires 75 Dungeoneering) or Elf Lands with [Extreme Hunter potions](https://runescape.wiki/w/Extreme_hunter_potion).

---

### 💡 Quick Action Items & XP Boosts

* **Use Boosts:** Drink [Extreme Hunter potions](https://runescape.wiki/w/Extreme_hunter_potion) (+17 temporary skill boost) to access higher-tier content (like Grenwalls or BGH creatures) several levels early!
* **Yaktwee Stick:** Equip the [Enhanced yaktwee stick](https://runescape.wiki/w/Enhanced_yaktwee_stick) if unlocked (+2% Hunter XP).
* **Proteans:** If you have [Protean traps](https://runescape.wiki/w/Protean_trap) stored in your bank, deploy them at high-tier trap spots for completely AFK, high-rate XP.
